newsitem.title: UK: BBA jumps on International Airmotive buy.
newsitem.headline: BBA jumps on International Airmotive buy.

text.p: Shares in BBA Group Plc jumped over 2.5 percent on Monday after the engineering group said it had agreed to buy International Airmotive Holding Company for 112.8 million stg.
By 1441 GMT the stock was up nine pence at 353-1/2.
"It's on the back of the aquisition, it's been well received and that's why they're better," one market maker said.
BBA said the total investment in International Airmotive was expected to be close to 176.2 million stg, as the group assumes International Airmotive's 63.4 million stg outstanding debt.
BBA said the acquisition would be paid in cash out of its existing resources, adding it expected to complete the purchase early in 1997.
